main_text.l: Suppurant; Fœnum græcum, Hordeum, Lilium, Lolium, &c.
Flatus discutiunt; Anisi, Anethi, Apii, Carei, Cymini, Dauci, Fœniculi, Nigellæ, Petroselini, Sefeleos, Santonici, &c.
Semen generant; Cicer, Faba, Erucæ, Lini, Fraxini, &c.
Menses movent; Amomi, Asparagi, Anisi, Ammi, Cicer, Dauci, Apii, Fœniculi, Petroselini, Sefeleos, Levisticî, &c.
Menses sistunt; Antorae, Cymini, Pæoniæ, Lappæ, &c.
Venenis resistunt; Ammi, Anisi, Apii, Cardamomum, Citrii mali, Fœniculi, Raparum.
Dolorem mitigant; Anethi, Amomi, Cardamomum, Cymini, Dauci, Ervum, Fœnugræci, Lini, Hyoscyami, Milium, Panicum, Petroselini, &c.
Vel denique strumas discutiunt: ut Althææ, Coriandri, Hordeum, Lentes, Lupini, Lolium, Lithospermum, &c.
